purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 503 Otite (city code 6712); city-bound registry evidence and safe anonymous parcel-geometry route.
primaryPublisher: Kogi State Geographic Information System Agency (KOGIS) / Bureau of Lands
registryBasis: Kogi State Executive Order No. 3 of 2022 gives KOGIS state-wide responsibility for land registration, state GIS, mapping all lands and managing the state land registry; it requires all land and titles in Kogi State to be registered with the agency. An official government project record names Otite community in Adavi LGA, Kogi State, tying the locality to that statewide jurisdiction. This supports registry jurisdiction, not a public local parcel dataset; no Kogi or Otite geometry route was verified.

officialSources.observation: Kogi State Executive Order No. 3 of 2022 establishes KOGIS and assigns it statewide land mapping and registry functions; order states all land titles in Kogi State are registered with the agency.
Government budget document names Otite community, Nagazi Ward, Adavi LGA, Kogi State. Used only to localize the named settlement to the state, not to establish parcel availability.
Kogi State official survey guidance is applicant/survey-plan oriented; it is not an anonymous map or geometry endpoint.
Official Kogi Ministry of Housing site search result identifies the state ministry; page open timed out, so no response status is asserted.

Official Kogi State structure page lists Adavi among the state council areas; used only with the separate government record naming Otite community in Adavi LGA to locate the locality inside Kogi statutory coverage.
